label: after
build: instant search: static index + Web Worker, suggestion code lazy-loaded on first focus/hover

keystroke_to_suggestions_ms.method: scripts/search-timing.mjs --wait-index: index loaded, t0 = input event, t1 = first animation frame after the suggestion rows changed; 6 queries, fresh context per query; median
keystroke_to_suggestions_ms.note: no debounce, no server round trip; the engine answers in the worker. Desktop meets the <16 ms target; 4x-CPU (a deliberately slow device) is ~45 ms, still far below the old ~340 ms and the competitor's ~225 ms

api_search_server_ms.note: /api/search is now only the fallback while the index loads; unchanged server time (see before.json). Now also emits Server-Timing: total;dur, db;dur.

index.downloaded: after the load event when the page is idle (home + search; skipped on Save-Data/2G), or on first focus/hover of the box on any page; cached in the Cache API for repeat visits (zero network)

lighthouse_mobile.method: scripts/lighthouse-perf.mjs: Lighthouse 13.5.0 default mobile emulation, 3 runs, median run; local server. Compare with before.json.
lighthouse_mobile.reading: score within 1 point and within run-to-run variance (a baseline-level run appears in each median's run list); CLS unchanged at 0; LCP/FCP within noise. The index and worker load only after the page is idle (home/search) or on interaction, so they do not affect LCP or FCP. The inflated transfer on the home run (~782 KB vs ~391) is that idle index prefetch, which the brief asked for, counted by Lighthouse because its trace continues past the load event.

first_load_js_kb_gzip.method: scripts/first-load-js.mjs (initial-HTML scripts, modern browsers, noModule polyfills excluded)
first_load_js_kb_gzip.note: +1.2 KB: the combobox plus the voice button that renders after hydration. The suggestion engine, client and highlight are a separate chunk loaded on first focus/hover; the SearchEngine class is in the worker chunk; the voice recognition code loads on the first microphone tap; the 379 KB index is never on the first load.
